structure.purpose: Start with hard-hitting statistic or relatable frustration
examples: Why are you still spending 20 hours a week on initial screenings?
The true cost of a vacant seat isn't what you think
73% of top candidates ghost companies with poor communication

structure.purpose: Briefly explain why this issue persists (1-2 sentences)
structure.approach: Point to systemic issues: outdated tech, generic platforms, manual processes

structure.purpose: Provide WHAT to do (high-level), NOT HOW to do it
structure.approach: Focus on value of outcomes, not mechanics of process

structure.purpose: Frame HirePriority as the partner that handles this complexity
structure.approach: Subtle transition from general advice to specific solution
